overall_notes: The extraction was generally accurate. Key points: (1) The paper focuses on headline generation as a special case of text summarization, (2) BLEU was used for automatic evaluation during hyperparameter tuning, (3) No LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted, (4) Human evaluation used three domain experts with clear criteria. The paper mentions ROUGE in passing but only used BLEU for actual evaluation.
